install_overlay.title: KiWin is installing
install_overlay.guidance: Please don't use your keyboard or mouse. You can watch as KiWin works.
install_overlay.dry_run_complete: Dry run complete. No system changes were made.
install_overlay.complete_no_restart: Installation complete. KiWin will not restart your system automatically.

browser.title: Welcome. Please select your web browser.

review.title: System is ready to debloat. Please review.
review.guidance:
The list on the left shows everything KiWin is going to do to your system. If there's something you don't want it to do, you can remove items from the list.

If everything looks good to you, select "Start."
review.no_internet_info: You aren't connected to internet. KiWin won't install a browser.
review.no_updates_warning: Update policy won't be configured. Updates may restore bloat and undo some of KiWin's settings.
review.nothing_to_do: Cannot start debloat process. Nothing to do.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.warning: Do not touch unless you know what you're doing!
advanced.winutil_tweaks_tooltip: One tweak name per line, e.g. WPFTweaksTelemetry. Applied by WinUtil during phase one.
advanced.undo_policy_done: Update policy removed. Windows will now receive full updates again.

remove_edge_permanently.tooltip: Uninstalls Microsoft Edge, and ensures it doesn't come back. You can always reinstall it yourself if you want. Apps that rely on it (msedgewebview2) will still work.

debloat_windows_phase_one.tooltip: KiWin uses a popular and well-established tool, WinUtil by ChrisTitusTech, as part of its debloating process. The whole process is automated, so you don't need to do anything. It is not recommended to remove this step.

debloat_windows_phase_two.tooltip: KiWin uses a popular and well-established tool, Win11Debloat by Raphire, as part of its debloating process. The whole process is automated, so you don't need to do anything. It is not recommended to remove this step.

configure_updates.tooltip: In order to prevent Windows updates from reintroducing bloat and undoing the changes made, KiWin sets an update policy on your system which results in only receiving security updates, leaving out non-security "feature" updates. It lasts permanently on Windows Pro, but only 365 days on Windows Home.

developer_mode.tooltip: When enabled, KiWin runs without showing the full-screen install overlay.

prevent_device_companion_apps.tooltip: Prevents additional software from being installed when plugging in devices (e.g. ads when plugging in a monitor). Poses potential security risk.

wpbt.tooltip: Prevents the WPBT firmware binary (a lower-level OEM mechanism) from running at boot. Some OEMs use it for legitimate purposes, but it can also be abused.

helium.tooltip: Helium is a lightweight, fast and modern browser focused on performance and simplicity.

firefox.tooltip: Firefox is not recommended unless necessary for your purposes, as it includes telemetry and sponsored content by default.

waterfox.tooltip: Waterfox is recommended over Firefox, but not Brave. It's based on Firefox, but removes tracking and telemetry.

brave.tooltip: Brave is the recommended browser, as it is the closest to Chrome while respecting your privacy.

librewolf.tooltip: LibreWolf is only recommended for tech-savvy users. It is designed for maximum privacy and security, but can be harder to use.
